title: 现在完成时 vs 一般过去时
explanation: 现在完成时强调过去动作对现在的影响或与现在的关联，不与具体过去时间连用；一般过去时强调过去发生的动作本身，通常有明确的过去时间状语。区分二者的关键在于是否有具体的时间点。
rules: 现在完成时：have/has + p.p.，不与 yesterday, last year 等连用
一般过去时：动词过去式，常与 yesterday, ago, last week 等连用
现在完成时强调结果或经历：I have lost my key.（钥匙现在找不到了）
一般过去时强调事件本身：I lost my key yesterday.

examples.en: I have lived here for five years.
examples.zh: 我在这里住了五年了。（现在仍住）

examples.en: I lived in Beijing for two years.
examples.zh: 我在北京住了两年。（现在不住了）

examples.en: She has finished her homework.
examples.zh: 她已经做完作业了。（现在不用做了）

exercises.question: I ___ (know) him since 2015.
We ___ (go) to Paris last summer.
找出错误并选择正确说法：I have visited Beijing last year.
options: I have visited Beijing last year.
I have visit Beijing last year.

title: 现在完成进行时
explanation: 现在完成进行时表示从过去某时开始一直持续到现在的动作，强调动作的持续性和未完成性。结构为 have/has been + 动词-ing。常与 for, since, all day 等连用。
rules: have / has been + 动词-ing
强调动作从过去持续到现在且可能继续
常与 for + 时间段 / since + 时间点连用
可表示刚结束的动作带来的痕迹：I've been running.（还在喘气）

examples.en: I have been studying English for three years.
examples.zh: 我已经学英语三年了。

examples.en: She has been waiting for two hours.
examples.zh: 她已经等了两个小时了。

examples.en: It has been raining all day.
examples.zh: 雨一整天都在下。

exercises.question: I ___ (read) this book since morning.
They ___ (wait) for over an hour.
找出错误并选择正确说法：She has been work here since 2020.
exercises.answer: She has been working here since 2020.
options: She has been work here since 2020.
She has been working here since 2020.

title: 被动语态（入门）
explanation: 被动语态用于强调动作的承受者而非执行者，或在不知道/不重要谁执行动作时使用。结构为 be + 过去分词。by + 施动者可省略。
rules: be + 过去分词（be 随时态变化）
一般现在时：is/am/are + p.p.
一般过去时：was/were + p.p.
一般将来时：will be + p.p.
by + 施动者（可省略）

examples.en: The bridge was built in 1990.
examples.zh: 这座桥建于1990年。

examples.en: English is spoken in many countries.
examples.zh: 许多国家都讲英语。

examples.en: The homework will be finished tomorrow.
examples.zh: 作业明天会完成。

exercises.question: This book ___ (write) by a famous author.
找出错误并选择正确说法：The bridge was build in 1990.
把单词排序成正确的句子（被动语态：1. English 2. is 3. spoken 4. in many countries）。
exercises.answer: english is spoken in many countries

title: 情态动词表推测
explanation: can, may, must, might, could 等情态动词可用于表示对事实的推测。must 表示肯定推测（一定），can't 表示否定推测（不可能），may/might/could 表示可能。
rules: must + 动词原形：表示肯定推测（一定）
can't + 动词原形：表示否定推测（不可能）
may / might + 动词原形：表示可能（可能性较小）
could + 动词原形：表示可能（语气委婉）
推测过去用 must/can't/may/might + have + p.p.

examples.en: He must be at home. The light is on.
examples.zh: 他一定在家。灯亮着。

examples.en: She can't be a doctor. She is too young.
examples.zh: 她不可能是医生。她太年轻了。

examples.en: It may rain later.
examples.zh: 晚些时候可能会下雨。

exercises.question: He ___ be tired. He has been working all day.
That ___ be true. It's impossible!
找出错误并选择正确说法：She must is at home right now.
exercises.answer: She must be at home right now.
options: She must is at home right now.
She must be at home right now.
She must are at home right now.

title: 定语从句（入门）
explanation: 定语从句（关系从句）用于修饰名词或代词，由关系代词 who, whom, which, that, whose 引导。定语从句紧跟在先行词之后，为其提供附加信息。
rules: who 修饰人（作主语）：The man who called you is my brother.
whom 修饰人（作宾语）：The girl whom I met is nice.
which 修饰物：The book which I read was great.
that 可修饰人或物（口语常用）
whose 表示所属关系：The boy whose father is a doctor...

examples.en: The man who lives next door is a doctor.
examples.zh: 住在隔壁的那个人是医生。

examples.en: I bought a phone which was on sale.
examples.zh: 我买了一部打折的手机。

examples.en: The teacher whose class I attend is very kind.
examples.zh: 我上的那位老师的课的老师非常好。

exercises.question: The girl ___ (who / which) won the prize is my sister.
This is the book ___ (that / who) changed my life.
把单词排序成正确的句子（定语从句：1. The man 2. who 3. lives next door 4. is a doctor）。
exercises.answer: the man who lives next door is a doctor

title: 虚拟条件句（入门）
explanation: 虚拟条件句用于表达与事实相反的假设。与现在事实相反：if 从句用过去式（be 用 were），主句用 would + 动词原形。与过去事实相反：if 从句用 had + p.p.，主句用 would have + p.p.
rules: 与现在相反：If + 过去式（were）, would + 动词原形
与过去相反：If + had + p.p., would have + p.p.
If I were you...（固定表达，be 动词用 were）
表示建议/愿望：I wish + 过去式 / I wish + had + p.p.

examples.en: If I had known, I would have helped you.
examples.zh: 如果我当时知道，我就会帮你。

examples.en: I wish I were taller.
examples.zh: 我希望自己更高。

examples.en: If I had more time, I would learn to play the guitar.
examples.zh: 如果我有更多时间，我会学弹吉他。

exercises.question: If I ___ (be) you, I would take the job.
找出错误并选择正确说法：If I have known, I would have helped you.
exercises.answer: If I had known, I would have helped you.
options: If I have known, I would help you.
If I had known, I would have helped you.
If I knew, I will have helped you.

exercises.question: 把单词排序成正确的句子（虚拟语气：1. If 2. I 3. were 4. a bird 5. I would fly）。
exercises.answer: if i were a bird i would fly

title: 间接引语（入门）
explanation: 间接引语用于转述他人的话，不使用引号。转述陈述句时用 that 引导，人称、时态和时间词需要相应变化。时态通常后退一步。
rules: 陈述句间接引语：主语 + said (that) + 从句
时态后退：say → said, will → would, can → could
人称变化：I → he/she, my → his/her
时间词变化：today → that day, yesterday → the day before

examples.en: He said (that) he was tired.
examples.zh: 他说他很累。

examples.en: She told me that she had finished the work.
examples.zh: 她告诉我她已经完成了工作。

examples.en: They said they would come the next day.
examples.zh: 他们说他们第二天会来。

exercises.question: He said he ___ (be) hungry.
She told me that she ___ (will / would) help me.
找出错误并选择正确说法：He said that he is tired.
exercises.answer: He said that he was tired.
options: He said that he is tired.
He said that he was tired.
He said that he were tired.

title: 过去完成时
explanation: 过去完成时表示过去的过去，即在某一过去时间点之前已经发生的动作。结构为 had + 过去分词。常用于叙述故事、比较两个过去的动作先后顺序。
rules: had + 过去分词
表示在过去某一时刻之前已完成的动作
常与 by the time, before, after, when 等连用
在叙述中建立两个过去事件的时间先后关系

examples.en: When I arrived, the movie had already started.
examples.zh: 当我到达时，电影已经开始了。

examples.en: She had finished her homework before dinner.
examples.zh: 她在晚饭前就做完了作业。

examples.en: By the time he called, I had left.
examples.zh: 他打电话的时候，我已经走了。

exercises.question: When I got there, the train ___ (leave) already.
She ___ (finish) dinner before he arrived.
找出错误并选择正确说法：By the time I arrived, she has left.
exercises.answer: By the time I arrived, she had left.
options: By the time I arrived, she has left.
By the time I arrived, she had left.
By the time I arrived, she left.

title: 比较级与最高级（多音节）
explanation: 多音节形容词的比较级和最高级分别用 more 和 the most 构成。此外还有一些特殊比较结构：as...as（同级比较）、not as...as（不如）、the more...the more（越越）。
rules: 多音节形容词比较级：more + 形容词 + than
多音节形容词最高级：the most + 形容词
同级比较：as + 形容词 + as
否定同级比较：not as/so + 形容词 + as
the more...the more：越越

examples.en: This problem is more difficult than the last one.
examples.zh: 这个问题比上一个更难。

examples.en: She is as tall as her mother.
examples.zh: 她和她妈妈一样高。

examples.en: The more you practice, the better you become.
examples.zh: 你练得越多，你就变得越好。

exercises.question: This movie is ___ (more boring / boringer) than that one.
He is ___ (as tall / taller) as his father.
找出错误并选择正确说法：English is more importanter than math.
exercises.answer: English is more important than math.
options: English is more importanter than math.
English is more important than math.
English is most important than math.

title: used to 结构
explanation: used to 表示过去习惯性动作或过去的状况，暗示现在已不再如此。结构为 used to + 动词原形。否定形式为 didn't use to 或 used not to。疑问句用 Did...use to...?
rules: used to + 动词原形：表示过去习惯
否定：didn't use to / used not to
疑问：Did + 主语 + use to...?
不表示具体次数或持续时间，仅表示过去的习惯
be used to + 动词-ing 表示习惯于，含义不同

examples.en: I used to play football after school.
examples.zh: 我过去放学后常踢足球。（现在不踢了）

examples.en: She didn't use to like coffee.
examples.zh: 她过去不喜欢咖啡。（现在喜欢了）

examples.en: Did you use to live in this city?
examples.zh: 你过去住在这个城市吗？

exercises.question: He ___ (used to / uses to) wake up early.
I ___ (didn't use to / doesn't use to) like vegetables.
找出错误并选择正确说法：She used to living alone.

title: 一般过去时（不规则动词）
explanation: 很多常用动词的过去式不规则，需要单独记忆，如 go-went, eat-ate, see-saw。
rules: 常见不规则动词：go-went / eat-ate / see-saw
否定与疑问用 did + 动词原形
时间词：yesterday, last week

examples.en: I went to the cinema yesterday.
examples.zh: 我昨天去了电影院。

examples.en: She saw a movie last weekend.
examples.zh: 她上周末看了场电影。

exercises.question: We ___ (eat) dinner at a new restaurant.
找出错误：Did you went home early?

title: 现在完成时
explanation: 现在完成时表示“已经发生并对现在有影响”的动作，结构为 have/has + 过去分词。
rules: have/has + 过去分词
常搭配 already, just, yet
ever/never 用于经历提问

examples.en: She has already finished her homework.
examples.zh: 她已经完成了作业。

examples.en: Have you ever been to Beijing?
examples.zh: 你去过北京吗？

exercises.question: He has ___ (travel) to many countries.
找出错误：I have visit the museum yesterday.
options: I have visit the museum yesterday
I have visited the museum yesterday

title: 被动语态（一般现在）
explanation: 当动作的承受者是主语时使用被动语态，结构为 am/is/are + 过去分词。
rules: 主动：They speak English everywhere
被动：English is spoken everywhere
by 引出施事者（可省略）

examples.en: English is spoken in many countries.
examples.zh: 许多国家都讲英语。

examples.en: This bridge is made of stone.
examples.zh: 这座桥是石头建成的。

exercises.question: Rice ___ (grow) in the south.
找出错误：The cake make by my mother.
exercises.answer: The cake is made by my mother
options: The cake is made by my mother
The cake make by my mother
The cake made by my mother

title: 定语从句（who / which）
explanation: 定语从句修饰名词。先行词是人用 who/that，是物用 which/that。
rules: 人：The man who is talking
物：The book which I bought
that 人、物皆可

examples.en: The man who is talking is my uncle.
examples.zh: 正在说话的那个人是我叔叔。

examples.en: The book which I bought is great.
examples.zh: 我买的那本书很棒。

exercises.question: The girl ___ sings well is my friend.
找出错误：The cat which lives next door are black.
exercises.answer: The cat which lives next door is black
options: The cat which lives next door is black
The cat which lives next door are black
The cat who lives next door is black

title: 条件句（第一类）
explanation: 真实条件句描述可能发生的事：if 从句用一般现在时，主句用 will + 动词原形。
rules: if 从句：一般现在时
主句：will + 动词原形
从句可放句首或句末

examples.en: If it rains, I will stay at home.
examples.zh: 如果下雨，我就待在家里。

examples.en: I will call you if I finish early.
examples.zh: 如果我提前完成就给你打电话。

exercises.question: If she ___ (come), we will start.
找出错误：If it will rain, we stay home.
exercises.answer: If it rains, we will stay home
options: If it rains, we will stay home
If it will rain, we stay home
If it rains, we stay home

title: 情态动词 could / should
explanation: could 表示过去能力或礼貌请求，should 表示建议。
rules: could：过去能 / 礼貌请求
should：应该（建议）
后接动词原形

examples.en: I could swim when I was five.
examples.zh: 我五岁就会游泳了。

examples.en: You should see a doctor.
examples.zh: 你应该去看医生。

exercises.question: You ___ drink more water.
找出错误：He could to speak two languages.
options: He could to speak two languages

title: 不定式作目的
explanation: 不定式（to do）可以表示做某事的目的，回答“为什么”这个问题。
rules: 动词 + to do 表目的
可放句首：To keep fit, I run
与 in order to 同义

examples.en: I went to the shop to buy some milk.
examples.zh: 我去商店买牛奶。

examples.en: She studies hard to pass the exam.
examples.zh: 她努力学习以通过考试。

exercises.question: He opened the door ___ the cat.
找出错误：I study for get good grades.
exercises.answer: I study to get good grades
options: I study to get good grades
I study for get good grades
I study to getting good grades

title: 物主代词与所有格
explanation: 物主代词表示所属关系，形容词性（my, your, his）后接名词，名词性（mine, yours, his）独立使用。
rules: 形容词性：my / your / his / her
名词性：mine / yours / hers
名词所有格：Lisa’s book

examples.en: This is my book.
examples.zh: 这是我的书。

examples.en: The red one is mine.
examples.zh: 红色那个是我的。

exercises.question: That bag is ___, not yours.
找出错误：The book is my.
